channel.title: nexusEVnews
channel.description: Independent EV and renewable energy news, curated daily. Electric vehicles, solar, battery tech, and charging infrastructure.

item.title: The Electric C-Class Costs Almost £10,000 More Than a Tesla Model 3
item.dc:creator: Electrifying
item.description: Electrifying drove the C400 4MATIC in Finland. It starts at £57,995, tops near £71,000, and lands well above a Model 3 Long Range, with a cheaper long-range version due later.

item.title: Xiaomi's First Hybrid SUV Is Designed Around the Back Seats
item.dc:creator: Everything Electric APAC
item.description: Everything Electric APAC tours the Sky Nomad N90, a large three-row hybrid with a rotating-seat lounge mode, a fridge, and 1,700 km of combined range on the CLTC cycle.

item.title: Out of Spec's Lucid Gravity Tester Stickers at $121,150
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Reviews
item.description: A 2027 Gravity Grand Touring loaner specced by the host, said to hold around 225 kW on a Supercharger through boost, and rated the better buy over a pricier Cayenne.

item.title: EcoFlow's New Stream Doubles Solar Input to 5,000 Watts
item.dc:creator: UpsideDownFork
item.description: UpsideDownFork covers the second-gen Stream: PV input up to 5,000 watts, a full aluminum case, stackable batteries, and an early-bird start on August 12 ahead of a September 15 launch.

item.title: 2,500 Miles in the Rivian R2 Turned Up One Real Defect
item.dc:creator: RivianTrackr
item.description: RivianTrackr drove a new R2 Performance from Illinois to Florida. Hands-free impressed, the software threw minor bugs, and one rear door trim piece kept popping loose.

item.title: Ferrari's EV Splits Its Power Three Ways, From 320 kW to 725 kW
item.dc:creator: Auto Focus
item.description: Auto Focus drove a camouflaged Luce prototype on a private track. Range mode is rear-drive and capped at 320 kW, tour mode adds the front axle at 460 kW, and performance mode releases 725 kW.

item.title: The Electric Mercedes GLA Starts at £45,400 With 800-Volt Charging
item.dc:creator: Electrifying
item.description: Electrifying reports UK prices from £45,400, a dedicated EV platform, 800 volt architecture allowing 320 kW DC charging, and up to 408 miles quoted on the larger battery.

item.title: Top Gear Drove the Luce and Found a Ferrari Under the Styling
item.dc:creator: Top Gear
item.description: A pre-production Luce on track: 1,035 bhp from four motors, 2,260 kg, a 0.25 drag coefficient, and torque delivery split into five steps to mimic engine braking.

item.title: Eleven Energy Says Its Sodium Battery Held 85 Percent After 13,000 Cycles
item.dc:creator: Everything Electric TECH
item.description: Everything Electric visits two UK homes running Eleven Energy sodium-ion packs, with 13,000 test cycles at 85 percent retention and real tariff numbers from a solar installer.

item.title: The R2 Hit 77 Percent of Its EPA Range While the Model Y Beat Its Own
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Reviews
item.description: Rated at 330 miles, the R2 managed 253 at a measured 70 mph. The Model Y, rated at 306, went 310 on the same road in the same heat.

item.title: The Around the World E-Truck Is a Stock eActros 600, on Purpose
item.dc:creator: Electric Trucker
item.description: Electric Trucker picked a production 621 kWh eActros 600 over a modified expedition build, keeping the 4x2 layout and factory air suspension so viewers can order the same truck.

item.title: The Rivian R2 Tows Better Than Its 4,400 Pound Rating Suggests
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Reviews
item.description: Out of Spec loaded an R2 Performance to its maximum tow rating and measured an inch of rear squat, with efficiency falling under 1 mile per kWh at 70 mph.

item.title: What Car? Says the Mazda 6e Is Undone by Its Body Control
item.dc:creator: What Car?
item.description: The £39,000 6e wins on cabin quality, frunk space and warranty, but What Car? reports poor body control on undulating roads and rates every direct rival higher to drive.

item.title: Range Rover's Electric GT Goes Almost Button Free
item.dc:creator: Electrifying
item.description: Electrifying saw the interior of the fifth Range Rover model, an electric GT on JLR's EMA platform. The episode also picks apart why EV servicing quotes keep catching owners out.

item.title: The R2 Went 8 Miles Past Zero Before Turtle Mode Arrived
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Testing
item.description: Out of Spec Testing drove an R2 Performance from 5 percent to a dead stop on a closed track, and reports the reduced power warning arrived with almost no usable range left.

item.title: Janus Swaps Truck Batteries in Four Minutes Instead of Charging Them
item.dc:creator: Engineering with Rosie
item.description: Engineering with Rosie visited Janus Electric's Gosford plant, where diesel prime movers are converted in about six days and drivers swap their own packs in four minutes.

item.title: The Self-Driving Story Nobody Is Telling
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: The autonomy debate is all horse race. But for millions of people who cannot drive, a car that drives itself is the keys, handed back. Why Rivian's road to Level 4 matters more than the spec sheet, and the one thing it still has to get right.

item.title: We Built the Tracker We Wish Existed When We Were Waiting for Our R1s
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: People were reading website source code to find out when their Rivian was coming. Forum signatures listed Guide contact dates like military service records. We are not doing that again for the R2. The Rivian R2 Delivery Tracker is live.

item.title: Two Batteries, One Hitch, and the Case for All-Electric Glamping
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: The Lightship AE1 carries its own 69 kWh battery and 80 kW motor to neutralize trailer drag on the tow vehicle. Paired with a Rivian, the real-world efficiency numbers are hard to argue with. This is what all-electric glamping looks like when the hardware actually works.

item.title: Atlanta, Rivian, and the Quiet Coincidence
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: Atlanta has a failing air quality grade and a Rivian plant on its doorstep. A hypothetical about what one city could do with the electric mobility infrastructure that already exists — R2 autonomous taxis, ALSO cargo quads, e-bikes, and ZTL-style restricted zones — and what the health data says the stakes actually are. Includes data from the HEI lockdown air quality study (Chen et al., 2025) and the American Lung Association's 2025 Atlanta air quality report.
